title: How a Mobile Balances, and Mobiles 1 to 3
description: Left: two rule mobiles, one with 4 on top holding 2 and 2 and hanging level, one with 7 on top holding 4 and 3 and tilting towards the 4. Right: mobile 1 (16 on top, leaf, bud, leaf against a flower, leaf weighs 3), mobile 2 (24 on top, star, fish, star against fish and submarine, star weighs 2) and mobile 3 (8 on top, a book against a small level bar with two pencil boxes), each with empty boxes for the unknown weights.

title: Mobiles 4 and 5
description: Mobile 4 has 18 on top: a sun and 4 clouds on the left, 3 lightning bolts on the right, and the sun weighs 5. Mobile 5 has 40 on top: a crown and 5 gems on the left, 4 crowns on the right. Unknown weights are empty boxes.

title: Sack Scales 1 to 4
description: Four level scales. Scale 1: a sack and 2 kg against 10 kg and 2 kg. Scale 2: 2 sacks against 10 kg, 4 kg and a sack. Scale 3: 5 sacks against 1 kg, two 10 kg blocks and 2 sacks. Scale 4: 90 sacks and 50 kg against 60 sacks and 500 kg. Each has an empty box for the weight of one sack.

title: Mobiles 6 to 8, Held by Hand
description: Three hand-held level mobiles. Mobile 6: 3 bread slices against 2 eggs, a bread slice weighs 2. Mobile 7: 4 crosses against donut, cross, donut, a cross weighs 4. Mobile 8: a watermelon against banana, orange, banana; the watermelon weighs 10 and the orange 4. Unknowns are empty boxes.

topic_name: From a Pattern to an Equation
title: Matchstick Triangles, Positions 1 to 4
description: A row of four matchstick arrangements of triangles joined side by side, alternately up and down: 1, 2, 3 and 4 triangles using 3, 5, 7 and 9 sticks, with position numbers 1 to 4 below.

topic_name: From a Pattern to an Equation
title: Two Stick Patterns
description: Two stick patterns are displayed in two rows, built from thin amber sticks with dark outlines. The top row, labelled "Pattern A", shows three shapes: position "1" has one square with a triangle cap on the right, position "2" has two squares in a row with a triangle cap, and position "3" has three squares with a triangle cap. The bottom row, labelled "Pattern B", shows four descending staircases of squares: position "1" has four squares, position "2" has seven squares, position "3" has ten squares, and position "4" has thirteen squares. Each figure has its position number centred underneath.

topic_name: From a Pattern to an Equation
title: Blobs Hiding Dots
description: Three identical solid black irregular blobs sit in a horizontal row across the centre of a white background. Between the first and second blob are two small circular blue dots with dark outlines, one higher and one lower. Between the second and third blob are another two matching blue dots, also arranged vertically, giving a total of four visible dots separated from the blobs. Towards the upper right corner sits a light blue rounded rectangular badge containing the exact printed text "25 dots".

topic_name: Trial and Error, and a Better Way
title: Chain Machines: Find the Inputs
description: Two stacked panels show function machines. The upper panel, labelled "Machine A", contains three horizontal chains. The first chain shows an input box with "12", followed by a blue "+3" box, an intermediate value "15", an orange "×4" box, an intermediate value "60", a green "−5" box, and an output box with "55". The next two chains begin with unknown input "?", pass through "+3", "×4", and "−5", and end with "43" and "75". description: Three two-path machine diagrams are stacked vertically, separated by grey lines. In each diagram, an input box splits into two paths: an upper path through an amber box labelled '×3' and a lower path through a blue box labelled '+3'. Both paths enter a green subtraction box labelled '−', with the upper arrow marked 'first' entering from above and the lower arrow marked 'second' entering from below, followed by an equals sign and an output box. labels: arrow label: minus sign then the digits four, four
description: A board of twelve rounded boxes in four rows and three columns is joined by twenty-three two-headed arrows. The top-left box, shaded green under the word "START", shows the solved equation steps "8x = 20 + 3x", "8x − 3x = 20", "5x = 20", "x = 20/5", and "x = 4", pointing downward to a green arrow labeled "4". Below the bottom-right box sits "END". title: Ranjana's T-Shaped Tile Steps 1 to 4
description: Four T-shaped tile arrangements, Steps 1 to 4, with 4, 7, 10 and 13 square tiles. Each has one reddish purple centre tile and three equal teal arms (left, right and down) of 1, 2, 3 and 4 tiles.

title: Window Grill: Borders, Rods and Equal Gaps
description: A front view of a rectangular window grill showing its vertical dimensions. At the top and bottom are two blue horizontal borders, each marked on the right with a short double-headed arrow labelled 3 cm. Between them, five horizontal amber rods alternate with six equal white gaps, starting and ending with a gap. The first amber rod is marked on the right with an arrow labelled 2 cm. Beside the fourth gap, an arrow sits next to an empty reddish-purple outline box followed by cm. On the left, a tall grey double-headed arrow spans the full height, labelled 34 cm.

title: Two Triangles with Angles in Letters
description: Two triangles sit side by side. The left triangle is light blue with a darker blue border and points upward. Its two sloping sides each have one black tick mark, while the base has none. Inside, grey arcs mark its three angles: the apex angle is labelled "y", and each base angle is labelled "y + 15". The right triangle is pale yellow with an amber border and three unequal sides with no tick marks. Grey arcs mark its angles, labelled "x" at the top, "x − 10" at the bottom left, and "x + 10" at the bottom right.

title: Two Equation Chains Drawn as Ladders
description: Two ladders of equations. Chain 1 runs y + 1 = 6, −y − 1 = −6, −1 = −6 + y, 5 = y; Chain 2 runs 3y = 15, 3y + 6 = 21, y + 2 = 7, y = 5. Each step down is labelled with its operation, and an upward arrow beside each ladder is marked going up: inverse operations.
